description: Review rubric for notes-library cards (chapter notes, concept cards, one-shot summaries, glossary cards).

criteria.label: Factual accuracy
criteria.description: All statements are correct per NCERT + standard reference. No hallucinated facts.

criteria.label: Pedagogical clarity
criteria.description: Builds the idea up well. Defines terms before using them. Structure is scannable. Right depth for Class 11/12.

criteria.label: Appropriate depth
criteria.description: Neither too shallow (just NCERT paraphrase) nor too deep (PhD-level tangent). Hits the JEE/NEET sweet spot.

criteria.label: Source grounding
criteria.description: Stays close to NCERT + SME source. No invented anecdotes. Citations / chapter refs where appropriate.

criteria.label: Style fit (if A/B variant)
criteria.description: If the card carries explanation_style, does the prose actually match the style (concise / detailed / analogy_led)?

approval_rule: All min-pass criteria met. Style-fit criterion only weighted when explanation_style is set.
